I think it would be nice to support goto definition for namespaces, e.g. clicking on the namespace after open command can show all declarations in that namespace. I have a draft patch which does something like:

However, I haven't measured the change of .olean file size after having this new environment extension recording DeclarationRanges on namespace. Also in the screenshot above theorem is highlighted because namespaced declarations get expanded to namespace $ns ... end $ns where $ns was created from declTk, and I think a better visual design here could be highlighting the namespace prefix in declaration's name, in order to be consistent with namespace command. I guess I could open an RFC for this potential feature?
